visual.detailed_description: White-background image with two bordered tables and a legend between them. The first table has headings Test name, Conc, Unit and Corr MoM and rows b-hCG, NT and PAPP-A with printed values. A legend in italic text defines Corr MoM, Conc, b-hCG, NT and PAPP-A. The second table has headings Chance, Age-related chance at term and Individual chance at term with rows for Down's syndrome chance and Edward's/Patau's syndrome chance; the last column prints INCREASED CHANCE in red in both rows. No faces, photographs or patient identifiers are present.

Italic legend lines define Corr MoM as corrected multiple of median, Conc as concentration, b-hCG as beta human chorionic gonadotrophin, NT as nuchal translucency and PAPP-A as Pregnancy-Associated Plasma Protein-A. Bottom table: Down's syndrome chance, age-related chance at term 1 in 1200, individual chance at term >1 in 2; Edward's/Patau's syndrome chance, age-related <1 in 5000, individual 1 in 4; INCREASED CHANCE in red in both rows.

visual.general_description: Three side-by-side color intraoperative photographs of gloved hands holding bowel and tissue, with white arrows.
visual.detailed_description: Three unlettered color photographs side by side. The left photograph shows a gloved hand holding a thin red tubular structure with a dark tip, a rounded dark mottled mass at the lower left, and a white double-headed arrow with two ends pointing at the tubular structure and the area near the mass. The middle photograph shows gloved hands holding a pink bowel segment with a dark gray patch on its surface and a white double-headed arrow pointing toward the patch and toward dark red tissue below. The right photograph shows loops of pink bowel held by gloved hands, with a single white arrow pointing at a small dark spot on one loop. Blood staining and surgical drapes are visible; no face or text is visible.

panels.general_description: Three unlettered color intraoperative photographs of bowel and abdominal tissue held by gloved hands, with white arrows.
panels.detailed_description: Left image: gloved fingers hold a thin red tubular structure whose end is dark, white gauze and a metallic cylindrical object at the upper left, a rounded dark mottled mass below, and a white arrow with two heads. Middle image: gloved hands hold a pink bowel loop bearing a dark gray patch, with dark red tissue at the bottom and a white arrow with two heads. Right image: pink bowel loops with orange-yellow fat, gloved hands at the right and bottom, blue drape at the lower right, and one white arrow pointing at a small dark spot. Blood staining on gloves and tissue in all three.
